summary: Sample app created: a small Python LangChain-style agent that embeds correspondent profiles, stores embeddings in Azure DocumentDB, and searches sanctions/adverse-media entries. The repo includes seeding scripts, a FastAPI endpoint (/review), and fallback logic so the sample runs even when server-side search features are limited. I installed dependencies, seeded the provided cluster, injected synthetic embeddings for verification when an embedding API key was not present, and executed a sample review for correspondent 'corr_1'.
how_to_run: 1) Copy .env.example to .env and fill DOCUMENTDB_URI (required) and OPENAI_API_KEY (optional). 2) Create & activate a Python venv (python -m venv .venv; source .venv/bin/activate). 3) pip install -r requirements.txt. 4) python -m src.seed  # creates collections & loads seed data. 5) If you do not have OPENAI_API_KEY and want to verify vector-based flows, run: python -m src.fill_embeddings  # injects deterministic synthetic embeddings for demo. 6) Start the API: uvicorn src.main:app --reload. 7) POST to /review with JSON {"correspondent_id":"corr_1"}. Notes: If you provide OPENAI_API_KEY the agent will call OpenAI for embeddings and narrative; otherwise the sample uses synthetic embeddings and returns a placeholder narrative.
verification_done: python -m src.seed: succeeded (collections created and seed documents loaded).
python -m src.fill_embeddings: succeeded (injected deterministic synthetic embeddings for docs without embeddings).
python -m src.agent corr_1: succeeded (returned risk_score, matched entries; narrative was disabled because OPENAI_API_KEY not set).
python -m src.db (index creation): attempted — vector index creation ran; 'createSearchIndexes' returned CommandNotSupported on this cluster (logged).
not_verified: Server-side 'createSearchIndexes' support: createSearchIndexes returned CommandNotSupported on this cluster so built-in full-text index creation was not available. (Reason: db.command({"createSearchIndexes": ...}) returned code 115 CommandNotSupported.)

Vector index availability on all collections: an attempt was made to create cosmosSearch vector indexes (vector-hnsw) on correspondents, sanctions, and adverse_media. The correspondents vector index existed; vector similarity queries against sanctions/adverse_media reported 'Similarity index was not found' during testing — I could not confirm server accepted/activated vector indexes on those collections.

LLM-powered narrative generation: not executed because OPENAI_API_KEY was not set in the run environment; the code paths for OpenAI embeddings and ChatCompletion are implemented and will run when the environment variable is present.
Hybrid BM25+vector fusion on the server: not validated because createSearchIndexes / server-side text indexes were unavailable on this cluster during the run.
open_issues: The cluster returned 'Search index creation is not supported yet' for createSearchIndexes — hybrid full-text search could not be fully demonstrated using createSearchIndexes on this cluster. The sample includes fallback metadata/text queries to keep the demo functional.

Vector similarity queries on sanctions/adverse_media returned 'Similarity index was not found' despite an attempt to create cosmosSearch indexes; cluster feature gating or index activation timing may be responsible. Operators with admin access should confirm vector-index creation via the cluster management tools or the Azure portal.
The sample uses OpenAI for embeddings and the narrative. If you prefer Azure OpenAI or another embedding provider, update agent.embed_text and the environment variables accordingly.

LangChain: the sample implements a LangChain-style agent flow but calls OpenAI directly for embeddings and chat completions to keep the sample small and explicit. If you require full LangChain integration, substitute the OpenAI calls with LangChain providers and chain logic in src/agent.py.
